blocks.text: To edit a privileged credential pool:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Credentials Management > Credential Pools.
In the table, locate the privileged credential pool you want to modify and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: The Edit Credential Pool window appears.

blocks.item: In the Edit Credential Pool window, modify fields as necessary. To learn more about each field, see Configuring Privileged Credential Pools.

blocks.text: You cannot change the Credential Type field setting.
To learn more about Privileged Remote Access (PRA), see Understanding Privileged Remote Access. To set up PRA, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Privileged Remote Access.
